Solar farm opens near Riverton

12 August 2026

The Riverton valley switched on its largest solar installation on Tuesday, a 240-hectare array expected to cover the annual consumption of roughly ninety thousand households. Local officials called the launch the most significant infrastructure milestone for the district in two decades.

Construction took nineteen months and finished ahead of schedule despite supply delays in the first quarter. The operator says storage capacity will be added next year, letting the plant shift evening demand away from gas peakers and stabilising wholesale prices across the region.

Grid engineers spent the last month testing the new substation, which links the array to the regional transmission ring. Farmers who leased land for the project will continue grazing sheep between the panel rows, an arrangement the operator describes as standard agrivoltaic practice.
